description: For bijections e : ℕ → A and f : ℕ → B, the map n ↦ (e(δ(n).1), f(δ(n).2)) is a bijective enumeration of A × B, where δ is the diagonal enumeration.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.productEnumeration_bijective.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (e : ℕ ≃ α) (f : ℕ ≃ β) :
  Function.Bijective (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.productEnumeration e f)
